name: not_json
description: The frame is not JSON.

name: not_an_object
description: A message is a JSON object.

name: no_type
description: Every message has a type.

name: empty_id
description: The id must not be empty.

name: bad_kind
description: kind is request, reply, or event.

name: no_reply_to
description: A reply names the request it answers.

name: known_type_wrong_kind
description: A known type must use its own kind.

name: missing_field
description: A known message needs every required field.

name: missing_nested_field
description: Required fields inside groups count too.

name: wrong_value_type
description: Values must have the right JSON type.

name: unknown_enum_value
description: Fixed value lists are closed within a major.

name: unknown_enum_value_in_list
description: Also inside lists.

name: null_text
description: null only where the schema allows it.

name: null_list
description: Lists are never null.

name: null_object
description: Required objects are never null.

name: null_group
description: A group is left out when it did not change, never null.

name: nan
description: NaN is not JSON.

name: number_too_large
description: Numbers must fit a 64-bit float.

name: integer_too_large
description: Whole numbers must fit a signed 64-bit integer.

name: envelope_key_case
description: Keys match exactly; a key that differs from a known one only by case is refused.

name: field_key_case
description: Also inside a message.
